children: Dennehy, who was appointed to the board of IQE in July, purchased the shares at an average price of 39.15p each, for a total value of £183,541.85.
As of 1530 BST, IQE shares were down 4.03% at 38.10p.
Reporting by Iain Gilbert at Sharecast.com
